userData key each tail InstancedMesh node uses to stash its particle simulation record: the live position/color Float32Arrays, the instance-buffer handles (aMat = instanceMatrix, aCol = instanceColor — so updateFx can flag needsUpdate), the seeded per-grain vectors (emission phase, lateral offset, stream rate, wobble, size jitter), and the layer's base dimensions (tail length, root spread, fan growth, grain size, tint, opacity). Storing the arrays here — rather than reading them back out of buffers — keeps the frame loop allocation-free AND makes the record inspectable without a live three.js renderer.
